packageRules.description: The OpenMetadata SDK pin is NOT a routine dependency. It must match the ingestion image the connector is installed into, and both series exist on PyPI, so a bump does not error -- pip silently downgrades or upgrades the SDK inside the image and breaks every other connector alongside this one. Any change here also requires docker/compose.yml, scripts/run-ingestion.sh and the constitution pin to move together. Dashboard-only, never automatic.
The ingestion container image is the other half of that same pin.
Dev tooling can group freely -- it cannot affect what the connector reads from a server. Matched by name, not depType: devDependencies is an npm concept and this project is pep621.
GitHub Actions: group so CI churn is one PR, not six.
